newsitem.title: USA: Aon Corp Q4 net down.
newsitem.headline: Aon Corp Q4 net down.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q4 1996 includes $60.3 million in special charges for restructuring related to acquisition of Bain Hogg Group.
Operating income from continuing operations before special charges $0.71/share vs $0.52.
Q4 1995 net includes $28.4 million in income from discontinued operations.
Q4 1996 per share results include $3.6 million in dividends on Series C preferred stock vs $5.3 million.
Q4 1996 revenues include $5.0 million in realized investment gains vs $3.8 million.
YEAR
(All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Full-year 1996 results include $22.4 million income from discontinued operations and $21.0 million gain on disposal of discontinued operations.
Full-year 1995 results include $99.1 million income from discontinued operations.
Full-year 1996 net income includes $90.5 million in special restructuring charges.
Full-year 1996 operating income from continuing operations before special charges (which excludes realized investment gains) was $2.97 a share vs $2.49 in 1995.
Full-year 1996 total revenues include $8.1 million in realized investment gains vs $13.1 million in full-year 1995.
